definition: Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network, an open dataset of CLIP-Filtered 400 Million Image-Text Pairs
details: Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network, an open dataset of CLIP-Filtered 400 Million Image-Text Pairs

explainer.lead: LAION-400M is an open dataset from the Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network containing 400 million CLIP-filtered image-text pairs. It matters as a large, freely available resource for training and studying image-text models.

tiers.eli5: It is a huge public collection of pictures with matching captions, filtered by a model, that anyone can use to teach computers to connect images and words.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers train or benchmark image-text models on it. A pitfall is that CLIP filtering and web-sourced pairs mean captions and images are not guaranteed to align perfectly.
tiers.paperLevel: Specified as an open dataset of 400 million image-text pairs filtered with CLIP, released by the Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network. Its composition is defined by the filtering step rather than manual curation.

explainer.example: A team pretrains a vision-language model on LAION-400M image-text pairs before fine-tuning on a smaller curated set.
